newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran debates a ban on foreign words, names.
newsitem.headline: Iran debates a ban on foreign words, names.

text.p: Iran may soon step up its campaign to wipe out Western cultural influences with a bill that bans the use of Western terms.
The Islamic republic's parliament on Tuesday began debating a bill that may end up banning Western terms in governmental and private institutions, newspapers said.
"The parliament started debating the bill...It will continue to debate it in the next session (on Wednesday)," Kayhan newspaper said.
The bill -- the Prohibition of Usage of Foreign Names, Words and Expressions -- received preliminary approval from parliament last year.
It is part if Iran's campaign to combat what papers have called a Western "cultural invasion".
The bill requires all government and non-government institutions to refrain from using Western terms in their reports, speeches, correspondence and interviews.
A list of commonly-used foreign terms has been drawn up to find Persian equivalents.
